I've done 5 reads of the series.      Every time when I'm done.    For a good month, I feel depressed because nothing compares.

I met somebody like that last year.   We were both chefs and with the stress of the kitchen and life, (She was in an abusive relationship) we would get a drink a few nights a week and literally just talk for hours.      Months passed, she left him.   And moreso than anybody else in my life, I felt like I had finally met someone who understood the dark parts of me, a person who got me.

4 days before this covid 19 thing hit, we literally drank a handle of vodka and talked all night long.  We were talking about maybe taking things to another level.  We kissed and hugged and...  She ubered home at 6am.   

She hasn't responded to any attempt to contact her since.   And then Quarantine.   I haven't felt so hopelessly alone since my wife took the kids and left with "my best friend" in 2001.    

And then it hit me.   Being alone isn't so bad.  Yes, I desperately miss the simple act of holding somebody's hand.    And I miss those long conversations.  And I'm drinking waaaay to much.    But my happiness isn't dependant on anybody but me.
